attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) as router for the private network (eth1, shared with node2/node3): assigned it a fixed static address 10.99.99.1/24, stood up a dnsmasq DHCP server on that interface for node2/node3, added firewall zone/forwarding/masquerade to route the private network to the internet-facing lan zone, and added two firewall rules rejecting TCP port 23 (input to the router and forwarded through it) sourced from the private network. Verified all settings persisted and remained actively enforced/serving after restarting all three managed nodes one at a time (node1, then node2, then node3), each confirmed via a changed OS boot_id.
